A type of <c:ffff00>stat<c> for the <c:ffff00>legs<c> <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c>.

Measures suitability for ranged combat, both
offensively and defensively.
The higher the value, the faster the <c:ffff00>{{shooting}} skill<c>
gets <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c>, and the more <c:ffff00>{{success}}<c>
<c:ffff00>Power<c> and <c:ffff00>Attack Power<c> its <c:ffff00>ranged attacks<c> gain.
It also raises <c:ffff00>defense power<c> and <c:ffff00>evasion power<c>
against the {{opponent}}'s ranged attacks.
